body: Sales and Distribution: the order-to-cash cycle. Sales quotes, sales orders, delivery, billing, credit management, and pricing. Integrates with FI for AR postings, MM for inventory reservations, and CO for profitability analysis.

author: reek
body: Cost of goods sold values each delivered line at the material master's standard cost. A material missing from the master values at zero, which the scenario gates catch as an inventory imbalance.
